scientific_integrity: The earlier random-clock model, its survival transform and classical Tauberian theory are acknowledged; new work is the exact mean integrability criterion and marginal logarithmic phase.
scientific_limitations: Independent resampling at deterministic periods; symmetric nearest-neighbor walks; fixed initial site. No correlated-rate or uniform moving-parameter assertion. Priority is not independently verified.
title: Sharp logarithmic borderline for the mean passage time of a randomly clocked walk
